messages:
morgan: Quick rollup — proposing we lift the v2 canary next Wed 09:00 PT. Owners: platform=morgan, SDK=jess, infra=samir, docs=lee. High-level plan: 1) SDK bump + client fallbacks, 2) canary @ 5% -> 20% over 3 hours, 3) monitor regressions + rollback window. Any blockers?

jess: @morgan thanks — SDK PR is ready but still needs a final integration test with the routing header. I'll ping the CI. Does the canary require a pinned model variant or is routing by policy ok?

morgan: routing by policy is fine for now, but we need to ensure the fallback path uses the legacy v1 endpoint when model compatibility fails. Add a feature flag in SDK to flip during canary.

samir: infra note — we have a maintenance window Tue 23:00 PT for the north cluster. Can we avoid cutting the canary during that window? Also need "deployment slot" reserved for the canary service for 4h. Who can book?

lee: docs question — what's the user-facing behavior when a request falls back? Do we return a 200 with a different schema, or a 409/426 deprecation hint? Need to update migration guide and add a quick compatibility table.

jess: SDK will return a structured fallback object: `{ "version": "v1-fallback", "note": "response may differ, see migration guide" }` and telemetry flag `sdk.fallback.v1=true`. I'll add the snippet to the PR.

morgan: Good. For API contract we should return `406` only if schema cannot be transformed; otherwise return v1 payload with header `x-redwood-compat: fallback`. Lee — can you add that to the migration page?

lee: Yep — I'll add a "What to expect during canary" section and a tiny diff table. ETA EOD Monday.

samir: Booking done — slot reserved Wed 08:30-12:30 PT on north cluster. infra-bot: scheduler:deployment_slot_booked by samir for canary service (slot id: slot-4592).

infra-bot: scheduler:deployment_slot_booked — slot-4592 reserved Wed 08:30-12:30 PT. See /deployments/slot-4592 for details.

jess: Pushing one more ask — we should also make the SDK opt-in for aggressive retries during canary so products can choose cautious behavior. I'll add `RETRIES_DURING_CANARY` env flag.

morgan: Agreed. Also canary config (proposal):
```
canary:
  start: "2026-04-14T16:00:00Z"  # Wed 09:00 PT
  steps:
    - pct: 5
      hold: 30m
    - pct: 20
      hold: 2h
  rollback_window: 4h
  telemetry_hooks: ["alerts:latency,errors,quality-regressions"]
```

samir: That looks fine. Can we cap token-rate per-second for canary to protect upper-tier customers? Suggest `rate_limit: 50rps`.

morgan: Added. We should also set an automatic fallback rule: if error-rate > 1% for 5m then rollback.

lee: Docs checklist — migration guide, quick diff table, canary behavior section, SDK samples, and note for product teams. I'll drop a PR by Monday EOD and ping here.

jess: SDK PR: https://git.redwood/example/sdk/pulls/482 — added fallback object, env flag, and tests. Needs `@samir` infra token for canary env vars and `@lee` for docs link.

samir: I added the env var key to the secrets manager, canary key name `CANARY_RETRIES`. I'll post access instructions in the PR.

morgan: Final ask — everyone add a follow-up baseline: owners confirm readiness by Tue 18:00 PT. If any team can't meet that, reply here with blockers. Otherwise we'll schedule the canary and post the deploy job. :thumbsup: 

jess: +1 — SDK on track, will confirm CI by Tue 16:00.

samir: +1 — infra slot and secrets done.

lee: +1 — docs draft incoming.

morgan: Thanks all. I'll create the canary deploy job and share the link when scheduled.
